meta.name: FST Settat WorldLayout
meta.warning: Normalized, approximate, read by eye from the satellite image. Heights, floors and facades are UNKNOWN and deliberately not stored.
changes: Added the Buvette (BUVETTE) across the west road at the former library's latitude (replaces the satellite-only building W_ACR2).
White halls HALL_W / HALL_E are carports (rows of white umbrella shades); W_STRIP is a greenhouse.
Courts: Administration, Building 4 and the connector patios get a checkerboard floor; IT Learning gets its inner court; the fountain was replaced by a curved pergola.
Added features: curved pergola, mini football pitch, garden step terrace, speed bump.
Passages carry a style (colonnade) and a portal type (arch3 / brick) read from the field photos.

v0.5: corrections from the 25 jeu/réalité photo pairs (2026-11-20): terraces (terrain), grey slab paths, diagonal-checker plazas, trident fences, Buvette rebuilt, wild lawns, no steps on the east connector path.
